item.title: Free Software Foundation receives historic private donations
item.description:
Free Software Foundation receives historic private donations by Free Software Foundation Contributions — Published on Dec 24, 2025 05:06 PM Boston, Massachusetts, USA (Wednesday, December 24, 2025) -- The Free Software Foundation (FSF) today announced it received two major contributions totaling around $900,000 USD. About the Free Software Foundation The Free Software Foundation, founded in 1985, is dedicated to promoting computer users' right to use, study, copy, modify, and redistribute computer programs. Media Contact Greg Farough Campaigns Manager Free Software Foundation +1 (617) 542 5942 campaigns@fsf.
